ai-fashion-photography-revolution.bodyHtml:
ALBORI

Sweet, smooth and softly spiced. Albori begins with the brightness of pear and the gentle warmth of pink pepper over orange blossom. At its heart, roasted coffee and bitter almond meet jasmine and a hint of licorice, before vanilla, patchouli and cashmere wood leave a creamy trail.

Key notes

  • Top: Pear, Pink Pepper, Orange Blossom.
  • Heart: Coffee, Jasmine, Bitter Almond, Licorice.
  • Base: Vanilla, Patchouli, Cashmere Wood, Cedar.

Product details

  • 50 ml parfum.
  • 25% perfume oil concentration.
  • Unisex: choose by mood, not by label.
  • ₹1,199 inclusive of taxes.

How to wear

On clean skin, spray once or twice on pulse points such as the neck and wrists, 15-20 cm away from the body. Do not rub.

Ingredients and safety

Ethyl Alcohol Denat. (95% v/v, denatured with 1% v/v DEP), Perfume, Aqua, Propylene Glycol, IPM

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and irritated skin. Keep away from heat and flame. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.

grace-vs-botika.title: How to apply your DOMANI parfum
grace-vs-botika.description: A simple ritual for pulse points, moisturised skin and a fragrance that settles in its own time.
grace-vs-botika.bodyHtml:
Start with clean skin

On clean skin, spray once or twice on pulse points such as the neck and wrists, 15-20 cm away from the body. Do not rub.

Choose your pulse points

Spray onto the wrists, the sides of your neck and behind the ears. Avoid rubbing your wrists together; let the fragrance settle on its own.

Let it unfold

For the longest wear, spray onto moisturised skin. Most people enjoy 8 to 10 hours of wear, though longevity always depends on your skin, the climate and how much you apply.

First wear

DOMANI fragrances are for external use only. We recommend a patch test before first use, and avoiding contact with the eyes and irritated skin.

Choosing a signature

With the Panther Discovery Set, try one scent a day. Let each parfum settle on your skin for a few hours before deciding which one feels like you.

lookbook-production-24-hours.title: Tomorrow, worn today: the DOMANI story
lookbook-production-24-hours.description: In Italian, domani means tomorrow. We make parfums for the person you are becoming.
lookbook-production-24-hours.bodyHtml:
Domani means tomorrow

We make parfums for the person you are becoming. Concentrated, considered, and made to be worn, not saved for a special day.

Tomorrow, worn today

In Italian, domani means tomorrow. We chose it because a fragrance is never only about the moment you spray it. It is about who walks into the room next: the meeting, the evening, the version of you that has not happened yet.

Every DOMANI parfum is made with that tomorrow in mind.

Concentration over decoration

Our fragrances are made at 25% perfume oil. No filler. No dilution.

It is a simple rule: what is inside the bottle should matter more than the shelf it sits on. That is why we say our parfums are built for skin, not shelves.

The DOMANI belief

Fragrance as a decision, not a habit.

Made with intent

  • Unisex by design: scent has no gender.
  • Parfum strength: 25% perfume oil concentration, so the fragrance unfolds slowly on skin.
  • Honest luxury: a considered fragrance experience at a price that makes sense.

sustainability-ai-fashion.title: Your DOMANI order, from dispatch to delivery
sustainability-ai-fashion.description: Dispatch timings, delivery across India, cancellations and help with an order that arrives damaged or incorrect.
sustainability-ai-fashion.bodyHtml:
Dispatch and delivery

Orders are processed and dispatched within 24–36 working hours of successful order confirmation. Dispatch timelines may vary during product launches, promotional campaigns, festive periods, or due to unforeseen operational circumstances.

We partner with leading logistics providers to deliver across India. Depending on your location, your DOMANI order will reach your doorstep within 5–7 working days after dispatch.

Shipping and payment

Shipping is free on orders above ₹999. Cash on Delivery is available on eligible pincodes, and you will see it as a payment option at checkout. Once your order ships, you will receive tracking details.

Before dispatch

You can cancel your order at any time before it is dispatched from the warehouse. Once your parcel has been handed to the courier partner, the order can no longer be cancelled.

For a cancellation request, include your order number, the name and phone number used for the order, and the reason for cancelling. Prepaid cancellations are refunded to the original payment method or, if you prefer, issued as a DOMANI gift code of the same value. Cash on Delivery orders are simply cancelled.

If something arrives damaged or incorrect

DOMANI does not offer monetary refunds after delivery. Verified damaged, defective or incorrect orders may receive a replacement or an equivalent-value gift code. Claims must be reported within 48 hours of delivery with the order number, an unboxing video showing the sealed package being opened, photos of the item and photos of the shipping packaging with the label visible.

Contact DOMANI

Email support@domani.in for order queries. The live shipping, cancellation and refund policies provide the full terms.
